BiblicalUsage: Jacob called the place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first, and the Lord told Pharaoh that for this very cause He had raised him up, to show His power.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word but carries the whole turn of a story: what seemed one thing is set against what God is actually doing, and the contrast is where the meaning lives.
